lines.zh: 游来游去真自在，鱼儿游鱼儿跃。
lines.en: Swim freely, fish swim and leap.

lines.zh: 金光闪闪游水中，鱼儿活泼快活。
lines.en: Shimmering gold in water, fish lively and free.

lines.zh: 清澈玉壶中游弋，鱼儿自在嬉戏。
lines.en: Swim in the clear  jade  vase, fish  play freely.

lines.zh: 鱼儿游来游去乐，水中嬉戏多欢畅。
lines.en: Fish swim about, joyful in the water.

lines.zh: 玉壶中游动不停，鱼儿活泼可爱。
lines.en: Swim non-stop in the jade vase, fish lively and cute.

lines.zh: 鱼儿畅游水中乐，玉壶中自在游。
lines.en: Fish swim freely in water, joyful in the jade vase.

lines.zh: 玉壶中鱼儿游弋，欢快畅游不停歇。
lines.en: Fish swim freely in the jade vase, happy and unceasing.

lines.zh: 鱼儿欢快游水间，玉壶中自由嬉戏。
lines.en: Fish swim happily, free in the jade vase.

lines.zh: 鱼儿在玉壶中畅游，自由自在无忧愁。
lines.en: Fish swim freely in the jade vase, carefree and joyful.

lines.zh: 玉壶中鱼儿欢畅游，自在畅快无忧愁。
lines.en: Fish swim joyfully in the jade vase, free and carefree.

lines.zh: 我从壶口跃出又落回水。
lines.en: I leap from the pot's mouth and splash back.

lines.zh: 我的金鳞把水照成一片。
lines.en: My gold scales turn the water bright.
One swing of my tail and I turn.
I swim the pot wall, round and round.
The ripples are the path I draw.

lines.zh: 我从你靴子边擦着游过。
lines.en: I swim right past your feet.

lines.zh: 静止不动时，鱼儿悠闲自得。
lines.en: Still, fish are at ease.

lines.zh: 鱼儿悠闲游水间，静止时自得其乐。
lines.en: Fish at ease in water, still content.

lines.zh: 鱼儿游水间，静止时自得其乐。
lines.en: Fish at ease in water, still and content.

lines.zh: 玉壶中鱼儿悠游，静止时自在舒畅。
lines.en: Fish in the jade vase, still and at ease.

lines.zh: 鱼儿悠游水间，静止时怡然自得。
lines.en: Fish swim in water, still and content.

lines.zh: 鱼儿游水间，静止时自在舒畅。
lines.en: Fish swim in water, still and at ease.

lines.zh: 鱼儿悠然游水间，静止时怡然自得。
lines.en: Fish swim in water, still and content.

lines.zh: 鱼儿悠游水间，静止时自在舒畅。
lines.en: Fish swim in water, still and at ease.
I hang still in the water.
Two goldfish circle into a ring.
I blow a string of bubbles on the pot floor.
Only one faint ripple is left.

lines.zh: 我等玉壶大人的下一句话。
lines.en: I wait for Lord Gyokko's next word.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在壶水里轻轻扇。
lines.en: My fins open and close.

lines.zh: 看见玩家，鱼儿好奇游来。
lines.en: See player, fish curious and swim closer.

lines.zh: 玩家出现，鱼儿游来围观。
lines.en: Player here, fish swim to gather.
Fish curious, swim towards player.
Player nearby, fish swim closer.

lines.zh: 看见玩家，鱼儿游来围观。
lines.en: See player, fish swim to gather.
Player nearby, fish swim closer.

lines.zh: 玩家在旁，鱼儿游来围观。
lines.en: Player nearby, fish swim to gather.

lines.zh: 看见玩家，鱼儿游来凑热闹。
lines.en: See player, fish swim to join the fun.
I look at you through a layer of water.

lines.zh: 我的嘴一开一合，像在说话。
lines.en: My mouth opens and shuts as if speaking.
My fins hurt!
My scales are damaged!
My tail is injured!
My scales are hurt!
My fins are damaged!
My tail is hurt!
Two hundred hit points. I can take a few.
My scales hurt!
One of my gold scales fell!
I have muddled the water flow!
Come on, tasty bait!

lines.zh: 壶里的水一动，我就饿了。
lines.en: The water in the pot stirs, and I am hungry.
You like this?
Give it a bite, you'll like it!
This is a rare delicacy!
Come, feast on this!
How can you resist it?
Try this deliciousness!
This is your chance!
You won't pass this up, right?
Harder than you think!
Collide with me, and you lose!
Watch out for my body!
The goldfish swells; its scales prick.
A ripple and I'm somewhere else.
My body is tough!
Hit me, and you'll regret it!
Gyokko's fish don't get touched.
My body is inviolable!
Be careful of my body, don't touch!
Mate with me!
I was summoned. Where would a mate come from?
I'm willing to mate with you!
Let's reproduce together!

lines.zh: 玉壶捏出的金鱼，也想找个伴。
lines.en: A goldfish shaped by Gyokko still wants a mate.
Let's mate!
Mate with me, and you'll be pregnant!

lines.zh: 我这一身鳞，是血鬼术画出来的。
lines.en: Every scale on me was painted by a blood demon art.
Let's reproduce!
The water in this pot is just right for eggs.
I'm hungry!
Bait, thank you!
The world in the jade pot is amazing!

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，我开始行动了！
lines.en: Gurgle, gurgle, I'm moving!
Cool water passes through my gills.

lines.zh: 玉壶里的人造鱼缸真漂亮！
lines.en: The artificial fish tank in the jade pot is beautiful!
I love it here!
I found food, come and eat!
Help me find food!
Gurgle, gurgle, I'm hungry!
A Demon Slayer's flesh. One taste first.
Get him, quick!
Don't run; the water is full of us.
Don't leave, fish in the jade pot!
I'm going to swim to you!
Catch this fish, it's plump!

lines.zh: 我来了，准备迎接我的攻击吧！
lines.en: Here I come, ready for my attack!
My power comes from the jade pot!
Fish of the jade pot, follow me!
My fish mouth opens with two rows of teeth.
I'm targeting, watch my attack!

lines.zh: 我的攻击马上就要到来了！
lines.en: My attack is coming soon!
I found you in the fish群!

lines.zh: 玉壶中的鱼儿，躲开我的攻击！
lines.en: Fish in the jade pot, dodge my attack!

lines.zh: 我的攻击不会轻易失手！
lines.en: My attack never misses!

lines.zh: 玉壶中的鱼儿们，小心我的攻击！
lines.en: Fish in the jade pot, be careful of my attack!
My Blood Demon Art forms a row of water arrows.

lines.zh: 我的攻击将决定你的命运！
lines.en: My attack will decide your fate!

lines.zh: 玉壶中的鱼儿，我的攻击将带给你死亡！
lines.en: Fish in the jade pot, my attack will bring death to you!
My attack is targeted!
Taps mouth, creating ripples.
Stares intently, swimming close.

lines.zh: 张大嘴巴，试图咬住食物。
lines.en: Larger mouth, trying to bite food.

lines.zh: 游到攻击范围，准备袭击。
lines.en: Swims into attack range, ready to strike.
Jumps, attacking with its mouth.

lines.zh: 尾巴摆动，水面荡开波纹。
lines.en: Tail wags, creating waves.

lines.zh: 身体扭动，发出轻微声响。
lines.en: Body twists, making a slight sound.
Speeds up, getting closer.
Gently bites, testing the attack.
Swims near, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 咕噜噜，水泡从我嘴里冒出。
lines.en: Bubbles come out of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我从玉壶中被召唤而出。
lines.en: I am summoned from the jade pot.

lines.zh: 咕噜噜，水泡从我嘴边冒出。
lines.en: Bubbles from my mouth.

lines.zh: 玉壶中我被血鬼术召唤。
lines.en: Invoked by blood magic in the jade pot.

lines.zh: 咕噜噜，水泡从玉壶中冒出。
lines.en: Bubbles from the jade pot.

lines.zh: 咕噜噜，水泡从我的嘴里冒出。
lines.en: Bubbles from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我从玉壶中被血鬼术召唤。
lines.en: Invoked by blood magic.

lines.zh: 咕噜噜，水泡从我的嘴边冒出。
lines.en: Bubbles from my mouth.

lines.zh: 玉壶的血鬼术把我拉出来。
lines.en: Gyokko's Blood Demon Art pulls me out.
The water breaks first, then I take shape.
Fire burns me!
Fall into the void!
I can't breathe!
The goldfish's scales have all flipped up.
Arrow hurt me!
Magic burns me!
I'm starving!
Lightning strikes me!

lines.zh: 水做的身体，在这里散开。
lines.en: My water body scatters in here.
